Name: Easy Access
Author: LeFauxMatt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ulr2XSt.png[/img]
Provides easier access to producers in the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oszWv38.png[/img]
Easy Access is safe to add/remove at any time. It should work with any machine, including ones added by Producer Framework Mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GPXxDLK.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Collect Outputs[/b] - Hit a configurable key to instantly collect items from nearby producers into your inventory.
[*][b]Dispense Inputs[/b] - Hit a configurable key to instantly dispense eligible items from your inventory into nearby producers.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lG4kcA2.png[/img]
For ease of use, it is recommended to set config options from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[list]
[*][b]CollectOutputDistance[/b] - The distance in tiles that machines can be collected from.
[*][b]DispenseInputDistance[/b] - The distance in tiles that machines can be dispensed into.
[*][b]DoDigSpots[/b] - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from dig spots.
[*][b]DoForage[/b] - Whether or not CollectItems will collect foraging like wild onions.
[*][b]DoMachines[/b] - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from machines such as furnaces and kegs.
[*][b]DoTerrain[/b] - Whether or not CollectItems will collect from terrain such as trees and bushes.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fMhu2q8.png[/img]
See [url=https://github.com/LeFauxMatt/StardewMods/blob/develop/EasyAccess/README.md#translations]here[/url] for the current status on translations.
